 On the 4th at Suwon KT Wiz Park, Game 2 of the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Korean Series between the KT Wiz and the Samsung Lions took place.
 With KT having beaten Samsung 8-7 in Game 1 the previous day, Game 2 featured a starting matchup between KT's Ko Young-pyo and Samsung's Chris Paddack.
